opening.label: Opening
opening.title: First improve the army on the map
opening.intro: A militia foundation before specialist detours. The first five make a connected recommended path.

steps.title: The Endless Muster
steps.note: Open the shared militia branch.

steps.title: Archery Prowess
steps.note: Support bows you already field.

steps.title: Spearwall
steps.note: Improve the spear and Sea Guard escort.

steps.title: Militia Training
steps.note: Improve the ordinary infantry’s campaign usefulness.
steps.gate: Spearwall is the recommended incoming route; an alternate branch also exists.

steps.title: Precise Fletching
steps.note: Keep hunters and ordinary bow support useful as enemies improve.

steps.title: Light Ithilmar Armoury
steps.note: Reduce the fragility of the common infantry section.

details: Sequence versus availability
These are priority queues, not a promise that each next tile is immediately clickable. Follow the stated prerequisite path and live ordinary-building gates; do not construct Aislinn’s ship buildings.
No stale numeric bonuses

hunt.label: Shadow war
hunt.title: Veterans, ambushes and useful magic
hunt.intro: Finish the common bow foundation, then follow the ordinary magic/intelligence path when available.

steps.title: Precise Fletching
steps.note: Keep hunters and ordinary bow support useful as enemies improve.

steps.title: Seasoned Militia
steps.note: The rank-seven benefits reward keeping veterans alive.

steps.title: Arcane Studies
steps.note: Support the travelling caster’s magic reserves.
steps.gate: Obtain its ordinary settlement/technology gate in your live tree, not Aislinn’s Blessed Hull.

steps.title: Foretelling
steps.note: Reinforcement and item-search utility for an expedition.

steps.title: Protection of Loec
steps.note: Support ambush success and resistance to enemy ambushes.

steps.title: Disciplines of Hoeth
steps.note: Improve repeated casting once the army has a developed caster.

details: Avoid a premature long detour
Protection of Loec is valuable, but it is not a free first-turn ambush upgrade. Follow Arcane Studies and Foretelling rather than delaying the whole campaign for the last tile.

agents.label: Agents
agents.title: Build the institutions behind the hunt
agents.intro: More important for The Eternal War than for a short territorial offensive.

steps.title: Cultural Advancements
steps.note: Open the political/civic branch when it supports the route.
steps.gate: Its ordinary research gate; separate from Patrons of the Realms.

steps.title: Waystone Network
steps.note: The left civic path towards better character infrastructure.

steps.title: Court Advisors
steps.note: Prioritise before recruiting a new generation of agents.

steps.title: Upholders of Order
steps.note: The other civic path towards intelligence and unification.

steps.title: Spy Networks
steps.note: Improve the intelligence framework; still scout individual targets.

steps.title: Unite Local Nobility
steps.note: Develop the civic branch after its linked predecessors.
steps.gate: Court Advisors / Spy Networks links; meet the live parent-count gate.

industry.label: Recovery
industry.title: Construction and expedition support
industry.intro: Choose based on what is actually built and recruited; do not chase a resource unlock through an unnecessary war.

steps.title: Marble Stockpiles
steps.note: Construction savings are strongest before a major building programme.
steps.gate: Use the ordinary resource/building unlock shown in the research panel.

steps.title: Healing Salve
steps.note: General recovery is valuable for expensive veterans.
steps.gate: Use the ordinary resource/building unlock; not Aislinn’s Guest Cabin.

steps.title: Light Ithilmar Armoury
steps.note: Reduce the fragility of the common infantry section.

steps.title: Cartridge Ammunition
steps.note: Support Eagle Claws or a meaningful Skycutter contingent.
steps.gate: Check its ordinary military branch; no Dragonship required.

steps.title: Seasoned Militia
steps.note: The rank-seven benefits reward keeping veterans alive.

steps.title: Foretelling
steps.note: Reinforcement and item-search utility for an expedition.

details: Resource research is opportunistic
A useful captured resource can make a technology cheap to access. Its existence does not mean it is worth an ocean crossing before a live victory target.
No obsolete Shadowlands instruction
Old High Elf technology lists have changed. This guide uses current named research rather than treating an older From the Shadowlands recommendation as a guaranteed tile in every present tree.
